caseNameFull: Walter Nelson, Edwin Powell, John Hicks v. W. G. Potts, Treasurer of the State of Washington and W. S. Cunningham, Redmond Freight Company, R. Strain v. W. G. Potts, Treasurer of the State of Washington
attorneys: Mr. John H. Dunbar for appellee, in sup-, port of the motion., Messrs. Robert F. Cogswell, Edwin C. Ewing, and W. R. Crawford for appellants, in opposition thereto.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Dismissed for want of jurisdiction on the authority of Moore v. Fidelity and Deposit Co., 272 U. S. 317; In re Buder, 271 U. S. 461.
